name: MilDef Group AB (publ)
summary: MilDef Group AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells rugged IT solutions in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States, Australia, and internationally. The company offers IT equipment, rugged computers, KVM, switches, routers, power distribution, customer projects, and accessories; laptops, tablets, and handhelds; intelligent displays; special electronics; concept products; and fiber optic and keyboards.
